added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite or after_suite field, so there is no base/head gate-log pair to reduce; the gate logs it does name (gate-head.log 4 passed EXIT=0, gate-focus.log 71 passed EXIT=0) both label rev=737c9d7ef, so no added failure can be attributed from them and none is stored as a measured zero.

findings.text: follow-on: test_a_composed_review_dispatch_records_the_waiver drives only dispatch_portfolio_review, so the identical option added at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2783 for dispatch_code_review is unguarded and a regression dropping just that line would pass the suite.

follow-on: the repair dispatch passes unreconciled_override=True with no dispatch_options, so a repair queued on a held local lane relaunches without the waiver and is refused UnreconciledRuns — the same deadlock §10 repairs for reviews — and this file is outside this node's fence.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit 024aaac43 against its parent 737c9d7ef commit by commit; it changes four files (+326/-6) — two production callers gain the dispatch option, the stranded-review reader searches the run directory and the discards spool, and a 264-line test file plus a 33-line evidence fragment are added — and each path is inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_review_is_not_refused_for_its_run.py, which queues a review of a delivered run past the grace while the lane holds, admits it, and asserts the relaunch launches (tests/test_a_review_is_not_refused_for_its_run.py:120); a same-state implementation launch stays refused (:146); the manifest records 4 passed EXIT=0 at that file and 71 passed across the reflex/plan-review/queue-admission files, and the negative control reddens the reflex case.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to make every path that queues a review record the unreconciled-runs waiver in its dispatch options; reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1722 and reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2783,3386 now pass dispatch_options={"allow_unreconciled_runs": ...} at the reflex and both composed plan-review callers, so a held review is queued with the waiver the admission pass rebuilds on relaunch.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, commits 024aaac43cb9549893a5dce4664defd3c3bd374b, the two gate logs (gate-head.log 4 passed EXIT=0, gate-focus.log 71 passed EXIT=0) and the negative-control log, and it names the one declared write path it left untouched.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py, reckon/crew/plan_review.py, tests/test_a_review_is_not_refused_for_its_run.py, the evidence fragment and the figures dir; every path the diff touches is inside it and dispatch_admission.py is declared but untouched, named in the manifest's follow_ons.

justifications.durability: the reflex waiver is a real guard (negative-control.log reddens test_a_queued_reflex_review_carries_the_waiver_and_launches by the UnreconciledRuns refusal), but the symmetric option at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2783 has no test and test_a_composed_review_dispatch_records_the_waiver covers only the portfolio site.
justifications.evidence: the gate at gate-head.log (tests/test_a_review_is_not_refused_for_its_run.py:120) asserts the relaunch launches and the negative-control.log reddens it, but the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite/after_suite, so §10's "no added failure against base" clause is unevidenced and the two gate logs both carry rev=737c9d7ef rather than the reviewed head.
justifications.fit: the added code follows the surrounding idiom of reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1714 and names nothing the naming rules forbid, though the inspect-and-read marker built at :252 with next() over two candidate paths is a slightly unusual shape for this module.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1722 and reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2783,3386 record the option the admission pass rebuilds at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:147, closing the reflex and composed-review queue paths §10 names.
justifications.reuse: the change reuses the existing dispatch_options contract read at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:147 and promotion.discard_spool_path at reckon/crew/promotion.py:1368 rather than forking a capability, and no helper builds the option dict elsewhere to extend under.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff — reckon/crew/plan_review.py, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, tests/test_a_review_is_not_refused_for_its_run.py and the evidence fragment — is inside the declared write paths, with reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py declared and honestly reported as untouched.
